method: Compare JSXGraph scenes by container and stable object order/type; regenerated board ID prefixes are explicitly logged. Compare exact object names/types/fixed/visible states, type-role counts, MathJax and label counts, container dimensions and bounds. Compare non-text point coordinates and five finite-domain curve evaluations at parameter fractions 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, and 1. Text-label anchor movement and style fields are reported separately from geometry. This is a same-viewport production-build comparison, not a phone or physical-input measurement.

settingsCoverage.note: The snapshots include points, object metadata, bounds, and finite-domain curve evaluations, but do not separately serialize rational curve weights or range-input values. The linear-function route has a line object and no finite-domain curve samples; it is compared by object metadata, geometry and source review rather than curve evaluation samples.
